title: The gate classifier gives the push class to a content gate that only names GitLab as a product
goal: bl_authority.gate_class classes a gate whose question names GitLab (or GitHub) only as the product a kb fact is about, on an item that touches only kb articles, by what the gate decides (design), not push; a gate that chooses a push target or a remote stays push. Found at the 2026-10-14 correctness planning: BG-tl74zfyr's gate g1 (row or reason for GitLab's MCP server) was classed push (matched 'GitLab').

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;it={'id':'BG-x','kind':'bug','touches':['kb/public/agents/doc-lookup-sources.md']};g={'id':'g1','question':"Does GitLab's GA MCP server get a row in doc-lookup-sources.csv, or does the article state why it is left out?",'options':['reason: no row','row: add a ranked row'],'recommendation':'reason: no row'};c=a.gate_class(it,g);print(c);sys.exit(1 if c=='push' else 0)

notes: Second trigger word, 2026-10-14: ST-xlr5flob gate g1 ('Which langgraph commit should the PostgresStore CODE facts be pinned to?', options: the latest commit that changed store/postgres/base.py, or the latest langgraph-checkpoint-postgres release tag) was classed push (matched 'release') on an item whose touches are kb/public content only; 'release' there names an upstream package release a CODE fact is pinned to, not a push. The fix should cover 'release' (and 'tag') in content gates, not only product names. Third case, 2026-10-15: ST-a25p6qsy gate g2 ('Which source row backs the trigger keyword facts: the existing CI/CD YAML reference row S447 (gitlab master@56c82a97 ...) or a new row for the same file at master@9f1632e2?') was made blocking as class push (matched 'gitlab') on an item whose touches are kb/public content only; 'gitlab' there is part of a source url's repository name (gitlab-org/gitlab), not a push target. ST-52lihy7z (2026-10-15): gate 'licence' (which licence the new GitLab doc source rows carry, CC BY-SA 4.0 per the gitlab-org/gitlab LICENSE or MIT as kbid.py read it) was made blocking as class push, matched 'GitLab'; committed open as printed.
